_source: SIMULATED - none of this comes from SAP
_why: What a team is working on, how long they take to answer mail, and when they last updated you are not ERP data. A real version would read from a task system, a mail server and a calendar. SAP holds documents, not what people are doing about them.
_note: state 'nudge' means slow to reply or blocked on something you can unblock. 'ok' means on track.
